highlights.title: John Ternus sends first memo as Apple CEO teasing a ‘huge launch next week’
highlights.summary: New Apple CEO John Ternus sent out his first staff memo, thanking his predecessor Tim Cook, and quickly turning to what the company will do next, reports Bloomberg. "We have a huge launch next week that's going to be phenomenal.
body: The first thing up for Apple’s new CEO is the big iPhone event on September 9th.

Today, on my first day as CEO, I just wanted to send a quick note to thank everyone for the warm wishes. I also want to extend my deep appreciation to Tim for sharing so much of his knowledge and experience during this transition, and more importantly, for everything he contributed to Apple over the years. We’re so lucky to have had a CEO who led with his values and with such decency and humanity. We are all better for it and I’m so grateful he’ll be our executive chairman.

I’m just as excited about what lies beyond that, including the incredible products already in the works and the ones we haven’t even imagined yet that we’ll dream up and create together. There’s no team in the world I’d rather build the future with.

highlights.title: Introducing agentic video understanding with Gemini
highlights.summary: We’re launching agentic video understanding across our latest Gemini models for improved accuracy and lower costs and token usage.
body: Our new agentic feature for video analysis cuts token consumption by up to 88%, reduces costs by up to 66%, and boosts quality by up to 7%.

Google just launched agentic video understanding for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. This feature allows the model to dynamically scan video segments, which improves accuracy while cutting token usage by up to 88% and costs by up to 66%. You can start using this today by setting your API configuration to "agentic" in Google AI Studio or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.

Today, we’re launching agentic video understanding across our latest models: Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite. This new capability improves accuracy while dramatically reducing token usage and costs for video analysis. Similar to agentic vision, which combines code execution with Gemini models’ native image understanding, agentic video understanding uses Gemini’s native video tools to improve performance and unlock new capabilities for video processing like sub-second moment retrieval, more accurate anomaly detection, precise counting and more.

highlights.title: Experimental England storm to highest ODI chase in win over Ireland
highlights.summary: England breezed to their highest successful ODI chase after an iffy fielding and bowling performance as an experimental side beat Ireland by six wickets in the series opener at Leicester.
body: Maia Bouchier (104 off 95 balls) and Sopha Dunkley (73 off 61) smoked 143 for the opening wicket inside 20 overs before Bouchier went on to notch her second ODI century as England reached their target of 282 with 71 deliveries to spare.

Freya Kemp (36 off 22) drilled four fours in a row off Arlene Kelly in the 34th over - a feat Bouchier had managed off Jane Maguire towards the start of the chase - as the all-rounder dominated a 54-run partnership from 38 balls with Alice Capsey (41no off 40), after Capsey and Bouchier had combined to add 50 off 47.

England's previous record ODI run chase was the 267-8 they knocked off against Australia in Bristol during the home Ashes in 2023, a game in which Heather Knight and Tammy Beaumont posted the two highest scores.

With Knight and Beaumont now retired and team stalwarts Nat Sciver-Brunt, Danni Wyatt-Hodge and Amy Jones rested for this three-match assignment, Dunkley and Bouchier played the key roles, albeit aided by some error-strewn stuff from Ireland.

highlights.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Leaving Xbox Game Pass This Month
highlights.summary: Xbox has announced the latest batch of removals from Game Pass. On Sept. 15, 10 games will leave the service. The biggest name on the list is Cyberpunk 2077; CD Projekt Red's once floundering and now flourishing sci-fi RPG.
body: Cyberpunk 2077 was added in March, so it will have been on the service for only six months. Just last month, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was also removed from Game Pass, perhaps to incentivize players to purchase the upcoming remaster on Sept. 29. As for Cyberpunk 2077, the sequel is a long way off, but a second season of the acclaimed Edgerunners anime is set to be released on Oct. 20 exclusively on Netflix. That will likely boost interest in the game, which CD Projekt Red will want to capitalize on.

The roguelike Metroidvania Dead Cells is another big loss for the service. The 2018 title remains one of the best entries in the popular genre. Fans of Dead Cells will want to keep an eye on developer Evil Empire's next title, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, which will be released on Oct. 15. Spiritfarer, a deeply emotional indie about ferrying the recently deceased to the afterlife, is also worth experiencing before it leaves the service.

highlights.title: A newborn and child reportedly died of measles; CDC isn't counting them
highlights.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is excluding two measles deaths reported by Pennsylvania health officials last week from its latest update of national measles data.
body: The New York Times reported Monday that the CDC’s new director, Erica Schwartz, is behind the decision. Schwartz—less than a month into the job—reportedly ordered CDC staff to add an unusual statement onto the CDC’s website for measles surveillance data. The statement notes that the update will not include the deaths reported by Pennsylvania and continues: “At this time, available information does not establish whether measles caused or contributed to the deaths or whether the individuals died from other causes while infected with measles.”

The move comes after anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. got into a public spat with Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro over Kennedy’s anti-vaccine rhetoric. Kennedy then shared measles misinformation on social media amid news of the deaths, then suggested without evidence that the state may have “fabricated” the deaths and that the governor announced them with “giddy delight.”

highlights.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
highlights.summary: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
body: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use agents for onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. Their examples show what enterprise leaders can borrow.

OpenAI’s latest Enterprise Signals shows enterprise AI moving from assistance to execution at sharply different speeds. Frontier firms (those with the top 10% of AI usage) now generate 8.3× as many output tokens per active user as typical firms, up from 2.6× in January. The widening gap points to a deeper operating shift: leading firms connect agents to company context and tools, delegate more substantive work, and make successful workflows easier to repeat.

For leaders, the challenge is to turn that depth into work people can trust, measure, and improve. Leaders should also leave room for experimentation, including use cases whose value is not obvious on the first try.

highlights.title: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' Breaks Free of Streaming With New Physical Release
highlights.summary: Avatar Nation, rise up: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is getting a physical release. Paramount Plus and Alliance Home Entertainment announced that the film is coming to DVD, Blu-ray, and 4K Ultra HD. Pre-orders are available now.
body: The film arrived on Paramount Plus on July 24, 2026, to a largely positive reception from fans and critics — it has a 90% critic score and a 99% audience score on Rotten Tomatoes. However, even with widespread praise, the movie's release was marred by unfortunate circumstances. In one of the biggest Hollywood leaks in a long time, the entire film was uploaded to X this April after a reported hack.

While Paramount had previously said the movie would launch exclusively on its streaming service, many hoped the leak would push the company to release it theatrically, offering a unique experience compared to watching at home. Unfortunately, the movie only received an extremely limited run in select theaters. At least Paramount is now doing right by the film with a physical release, something that isn’t a given for straight-to-streaming movies. Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender will be released for Blu-ray and DVD on Nov. 3, 2026, and for 4K Ultra HD on Feb. 9, 2027.

highlights.summary: Apple is pushing for "expedited discovery" in its legal battle against OpenAI over concerns the company is actively destroying evidence, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.
body: A former Apple employee allegedly discussed ‘destroying the types of forensic data Apple needs.’

This is the latest development in Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI, which accuses the ChatGPT-maker of stealing trade secrets to build an AI device. The lawsuit revolves around three former Apple employees who recently joined OpenAI, including Chang Liu, who allegedly kept a company-owned MacBook after leaving Apple.

Apple accuses OpenAI of failing to inspect the laptop “despite having the MacBook in their possession since the start of the lawsuit” in July. Once OpenAI finally provided the laptop to Apple on August 21st, an inspection allegedly found that Liu “not only downloaded a confidential Apple circuit schematic but also used it in his work at OpenAI.” Apple also claims Liu and others at OpenAI were “well-aware” of Liu’s continued access to Apple’s third-party cloud storage system.

highlights.title: Double Fine will finally make Brutal Legend 2, but only if its new Kickstarter campaign reaches an almost impossible $100m
highlights.summary: Almost two decades on from its first heavy-metal-infused open-world game, Double Fine pinky promises it'll finally make Brutal Legend 2… if the developer's new Kickstarter campaign somehow manages to scrape together $100m (about £74m).
body: Double Fine slid out from under Xbox's ownership earlier this summer, after the console maker kickstarted another round of layoffs affecting 3,200 jobs over the course of the next year. Four Xbox first-party studios also changed ownership, with Double Fine managing to regain both its independence and its entire gameography ( Psychonauts, Kiln, and Brutal Legend included).

Now, the famed developer has returned to Kickstarter to raise money for ' Amnesia Fortnight 2026, Indie Reboot ' - a two-week game jam that'll eventually result in a retail-ready game, plus a behind-the-scenes documentary from the 2 Player Productions crew (of PsychOdyssey fame).

Double Fine's Brutal Legend 2 stretch goal is likely the studio holding onto its signature cheeky humor because, not to burst anyone's bubble, raising $100m on Kickstarter is almost impossible. The most successful Kickstarter campaign of all time raised $46m for a 3D printer. In the video gaming world, Shenmue 3 reigns supreme with a $6m haul.

highlights.summary: Metacore has officially signed an agreement with Supercell that means Merge Mansion and its team will become part of the Finnish firm at the end of this month. Financial terms have not been disclosed.
body: The two companies announced the acquisition in a joint announcement earlier this year, revealing that integration planning was already underway. Metacore closed its offices in Germany and Sweden and cut 159 staff at its Helsinki HQ as part of the move.

“Merge Mansion created a completely new genre and has all the ingredients of a game that can be played for years and remembered forever,” said Supercell president Sara Bach. “We believe in what this game can become, and really look forward to welcoming the Merge Mansion team to Supercell and working together on the game’s next chapter.”

Metacore CEO Mika Tammenkoski added that the team is “excited about the opportunities this creates for the game, our team, and our players,” and stressed that player experience remains the priority as the game changes hands.

Merge Mansion, credited with kickstarting the merge genre on mobile, retains a loyal player base. According to AppMagic estimates, the merge puzzler has generated around $7.7m in the last 30 days alone, and is thought to have earned around $540m since its 2020 launch.

highlights.title: Sarah Pound’s creamy, comforting store-bought roast chicken recipes
highlights.summary: Using a bachelor’s handbag as a shortcut, the cookbook author shares a cheesy chicken and leek potato bake, a chicken and bacon pie and a rich baked pasta. A store-bought roast chicken is one of my favourite shortcuts, because it’s ready to be shredded and made into something new.
body: Comforting and creamy, this simple and delicious traybake comes with a warning: be very careful not to eat the whole damn thing in one sitting.

Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the potatoes and cook for 10–12 minutes, until just tender when pierced with a knife. Drain and allow to cool slightly. Once cool enough to handle, slice into thin rounds and set aside.

Meanwhile, make the creamy chicken filling. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the leek and cook, stirring occasionally, for four to five minutes, until softened. Add the garlic and cook for a further minute, until fragrant. Stir in the flour and cook for a minute, then pour in the chicken stock and cook, stirring, for two or three minutes. Slowly whisk in the milk and cream until smooth. Simmer for three or four minutes, until thickened. Add the chicken and cheeses and stir until the cheeses have melted and the sauce is creamy. Season well with salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 200C fan. Grease a 25cm × 20cm baking dish.

highlights.title: New Android Drop adds remembered items in Find Hub, makes anti-nausea dots official
highlights.summary: Let's be frank: Some of Google's recent Android feature Drops have been duds, offering little more than an expansion of Gemini summaries and chat functions. The new September Drop does have some Gemini flavor, but there are non-AI goodies, too.
body: Since this is an Android Drop rather than a Pixel Drop, these features are coming to a wider range of devices. The OS version does matter, though. If you’re on Android 16 or higher, you can now tell Gemini to log the location of items that don’t have a tracker tag attached. Just tell the AI where you put something, and include a photo if you like.

This information will be logged in Find Hub, which has thus far been used for locating phones, earbuds, and tracker tags. You can ask Gemini to recall that information or simply check Find Hub yourself the next time you forget where you put that item.

Gemini Live is also getting a new feature called Guided Vision that could be a boon for accessibility. Guided Vision can help you locate objects in the camera frame or extract information that you can’t make out, like the text on a menu in a dimly lit restaurant. Gemini interprets the camera feed to help you find things, and it can even tell you how far away your hand is from whatever you’re trying to find.

highlights.summary: Google has a new suite of creative design tools for Workspace users called Google Pics, which aims to make editing and generating "professional-grade" AI images less cumbersome for businesses.
body: This new image generation and editing app is bringing graphic design to Google Workspace.

“While AI image generation has been a huge hit for personal use, it’s been a different story for business,” Google said in its announcement blog. “Teams have struggled to create professional-grade images for marketing campaigns, customer presentations, and product storytelling, facing inconsistent results, endless trial-and-error prompting, and cumbersome workflows across multiple apps.”

Google Pics is launching as both a standalone Workspace app, and as an integration for Google Docs and Slides, with plans to roll out to Drive “in the coming weeks.” For the integrations, Google says users can select an image in their document or slideshow to edit it with “Pics’ full suite of precision AI tools.”

highlights.title: Maia Bouchier powers England to record ODI run chase against Ireland
highlights.summary: Ireland: 281-5; England: 283-4. Bouchier hits 104; three 50s by Ireland batters. A century from Maia Bouchier led England to a record one-day international run chase against Ireland at Leicester on Tuesday, as they reached their target of 282 with six wickets and 71 balls to spare.
body: Bouchier missed out on selection for the T20 World Cup in June but remains a key part of England’s ODI plans, as they look to build a new team in the wake of the retirements of Heather Knight and Tammy Beaumont.

Here, Bouchier initially played second fiddle to Sophia Dunkley, who smashed a ferocious 73 from 61 balls. But when Dunkley sent a return catch into the hands of the leg-spinner Cara Murray, it was left to Bouchier to bring up the three-figure score which was there for the taking against a helpless-looking Irish attack.

England are contesting these three ODIs without several key players – Nat Sciver-Brunt remains injured, while Lauren Bell, Danni Wyatt-Hodge, Sophie Ecclestone, Amy Jones and Linsey Smith are being rested. The series therefore provides an intriguing glimpse into the future, with the 21-year-old Jodi Grewcock batting at No 3, and the off-spinning all-rounder Mady Villiers also making a white-ball return after two years in the wilderness.

highlights.title: Nvidia’s controversial DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd and requires serious GPU horsepower
highlights.summary: Nvidia is officially launching DLSS 5 this week, following a divisive announcement in March where we likened the AI upscaling tech to a "real-time generative AI filter for video games" and "motion smoothing for video games, but worse." DLSS 5 will officially be available on RTX 50-series desktop…
body: DLSS 5 is almost here, but only for NBA 2K27, and only officially for 50-series RTX GPUs.

When it was announced, Nvidia lauded DLSS 5 as “the company’s most significant breakthrough in computer graphics since the debut of real-time ray tracing in 2018,” and highlighted how the tech uses AI to make games look more realistic by enhancing a game based on its source content. Nvidia also stressed that DLSS 5 gave developers controls that let them decide how changes from DLSS 5 appeared in their games.

But accompanying examples shared by Nvidia were widely criticized and meme’d on for significantly changing how characters looked, such as the “yassification” of Resident Evil Requiem protagonist Grace Ashcroft. With the official launch, Requiem still doesn’t support DLSS 5, and neither do other games shown in the March reveal, including EA Sports FC, Starfield, and Hogwarts Legacy, so we don’t know how the final version of the tech might now appear in those titles.
Nvidia did not answer our questions about when DLSS 5 might come to any game beyond NBA 2K27, nor reconfirm that previously confirmed titles will still include the tech.

body: If you've been looking for a cool LEGO set to build this Halloween, this discount is absolutely worth a look. As a 3-in-1 set, this Haunted Mansion can also be converted into a Haunted Train or a Haunted ship.

LEGO's Creator line produces some of my favorite sets because of just how versatile these builds are. Right out of the box you can choose to go in three different directions, and each build includes instructions. Seeing as this set is marketed as a Haunted Mansion, that is likely the only build that will use all 736 pieces.

If you do buy this set and only have one specific build in mind, I suggest you start with that one first. I built the 3-in-1 Medieval Horse Knight Castle last year and found it a bit challenging to convert it to a different set once I put together the first one. It's certainly possible, but the instructions for each version of the set include which bag to open next, so once all of the bags are open you're stuck with a big pile of bricks rather than being able to sort everything one bag at a time.

highlights.summary: More than 170 Jewish artists, also including Joel Coen, Hannah Einbinder and Miranda July, have supported the actor after he criticized Paramount. A collective of more than 170 prominent Jewish artists and academics – including Todd Haynes, Joel Coen, Miranda July, Hannah Einbinder, Wallace Shawn…
body: The actor had been accused of invoking antisemitic tropes after he criticized Paramount Skydance, the media company owned by David Ellison, a Donald Trump ally. Ruffalo had spoken out about the $111bn merger with Warner Bros Discovery (WBD).

In a statement posted to social media last week, the actor had highlighted the links between Paramount Skydance, poised to become one of the biggest media conglomerates in the US pending a court decision, and Oracle, the technology company owned by Ellison’s father, Larry, that has long supplied software to the Israel Defense Forces and government. Paramount responded to Ruffalo, saying it was “troubled when antisemitic tropes are invoked in purported service of a business dispute”.

The letter, titled “Enough!”, dismisses the accusation against Ruffalo as part of an “outrageous smear campaign” and calls for the end to “the false and dangerous weaponization of charges of antisemitism against those who are brave enough to point out the obvious: that the assault on the Palestinian people and the assault on our liberties at home are deeply interconnected, and there is nothing antisemitic about recognizing that fact”.

highlights.title: This is what a supercar was like a century ago
highlights.summary: Bentley provided flights from Washington, DC, to Monterey, California, and accommodation so Ars could drive the new Supersports and ride in a preproduction Torcal EV, which we wrote about last week. While we were there, we went for a ride in something quite old.
body: MONTEREY, Calif.—Elsewhere on these pages, you can find our first track drive of the new Bentley Supersports. Shorn of its hybrid system and stripped back to rear-wheel drive, it's not only the most driver-focused Bentley we can remember, but it's also apparently the lightest car the company has made in 85 years. But you have to go back even further into the Bentley archive to find the first car to wear the Super Sports badge. And since Bentley had done just that, bringing along to Laguna Seca an example from the time, it would have been rude to refuse the offer of a ride.

Bentley built 18 Super Sports between 1925 and 1927, taking its standard 3 Litre model and shortening the wheelbase by 9.5 inches (241 mm). Like today's Super Sports, that shaved some mass and made it a more responsive driver's car. But a fast one, too. The radiator was more tapered and thus presented less resistance against the flow of air, although like many cars at the time, the bodywork was a matter of whichever coachbuilder the owner decided upon.

highlights.title: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT
highlights.summary: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.
body: A new Epic integration and Healthcare Public Data plugin help teams review authorized patient context and work with structured information from official sources in ChatGPT for Healthcare.

Healthcare organizations need AI that works across the systems and information central to care and operations. Patient context, medical evidence, public healthcare data, and organizational knowledge often live in different places. Connecting these sources in a governed workspace helps teams find the right information, understand it in context, and put it to work across the business.

Today, we’re introducing a new electronic health record integration that brings authorized patient context from Epic into ChatGPT for Healthcare, along with the Healthcare Public Data plugin for direct, structured access to official healthcare datasets like PubMed, DailyMed, and CMS Coverage. Together, these capabilities bring ChatGPT closer to the systems and sources healthcare teams trust, while supporting the controls and compliance healthcare work requires.
